meta.title: Kisumu County population: 2019 census and official projections (per-capita denominator; data layer, not yet on pages)
meta.rule: The 2019 Kenya Population and Housing Census count is the only census point. Later years are KNBS projections as printed in the Kisumu County Statistical Abstract 2024 and are labelled projection; a projection is never shown as a count. Per-capita values divide by the census count or by the projection for the same year, and say which. Nothing is interpolated or extrapolated by Takwimu.

denominator.rule: Per-capita fiscal values for FY 2019/20 use the 2019 census count; for FY 2020/21 to FY 2023/24 the KNBS projection for the calendar year in which the fiscal year starts, labelled projection; from FY 2024/25 no projection is held, so per-capita values for those years are not computed (gap).

print_differences.table: Table 1.1.2: County Population Projection by Sex, Number of Households and Average Household Size, 2019-2023 (2019 row, Total)
print_differences.explanation: Table 1.1.2 prints the 2019 total as 1,155,551, which is male plus female without the 23 intersex persons; Table 1.1.1, Table 1.1.3 and the text print 1,155,574. The census count 1,155,574 is used; both prints are kept (conflict register case population-2019-total).

gaps: The count is read from the county statistical abstract's print of the census table; since 27 Nov 2026 the KNBS census Volumes I and II (repository copies, MD5 matched) are held and print the same count (P01 also_printed_in). Household, housing, water, sanitation, energy and ICT indicators from Volume IV, GCP 2025, KDHS 2022 and the poverty reports are held but not entered: no itemised socio-economic dataset for Kisumu exists yet (gap research D).
2009 census and earlier counts for Kisumu were not transcribed in Phase 1 (the 2015 County Statistical Abstract is held).
No population projection for 2024, 2025 or 2026 is held, so per-capita values for FY 2024/25 onward are not computed.
Ward populations (35 wards) are not transcribed in Phase 1.
